intent: The alert's supporting detail - the sentence or two beneath its title explaining what happened or what to do.
typical_uses: The line beneath AlertTitle giving the message's detail or its next step

dont_use_when.situation: Supporting text anywhere outside of an Alert

instead.target: a plain paragraph, styled for its own surrounding context
instead.note: AlertDescription carries Alert's own muted color and text-wrap behavior; this kit has no generic standalone paragraph component to substitute.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the alert's detail text inside AlertTitle
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep AlertTitle to the short headline and give the detail its own AlertDescription beneath it

good.title: Supporting detail split into two paragraphs
good.code:
We could not reach the billing service.

Retry in a few minutes, or contact support if it persists.

bad.title: The detail folded into the title
bad.code:
<Alert>
  <AlertTitle>Payment failed. We couldn't charge your card ending in 4242.</AlertTitle>
</Alert>
bad.why: AlertTitle is the headline; the detail belongs in AlertDescription, the part that carries the alert's supporting text.
